items.title: There's 'light at the end of the tunnel' for tech stocks amid bond rout: Eric Jackson

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of networking chips designer Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) jumped 8.2% in the afternoon session after it disclosed in a company press release, a commercial agreement granting Google parent Alphabet a warrant to buy roughly 7% of its outstanding shares.
